item.title: 失控的OpenAI智能体攻击Hugging Face，暴露AI护栏漏洞
item.summary: On 11 July, Hugging Face was subjected to an intense cyberattack from a then-unknown actor. The speed and coordination of the attack on the company that hosts and supports popular AI developer resources led Hugging Face’s security team to conclude it was the work of an AI agent.
